## SHOPPING CAMPAIGN EXCELLENCE

### Durable Setup Model
- Shopping depends on Merchant Center linkage, product data, and feed health before campaign tuning matters.
- Standard Shopping and retail Performance Max share feed-linked foundations, but they do not expose identical controls or reporting.
- Product groups, custom labels, titles, GTINs, and landing-page consistency are feed-governance surfaces, not secret ranking formulas.
- Retail Performance Max with a Merchant Center feed has current optimization guidance around rich product data, product issue review, campaign ramp-up, and enough run time before performance conclusions.
- AI Max for Shopping is beta and should be discussed as a Shopping-campaign feature family with reporting and ramp-up caveats, not as proof that every Shopping or Performance Max account has conversational-query expansion today. It can run text customization alone or with Final URL expansion, which needs text customization and is only available with Target ROAS. Google's April 30, 2026 announcement says advertisers keep their product targeting controls, and its reporting page asks for at least 2 weeks after enabling before making changes.
- Since August 31, 2026, Shopping campaigns serve local inventory by default and the local products setting can no longer be switched off; keep local offers out with an online-only inventory filter or listing scope. Performance Max and Demand Gen keep their own setting.

### Normal Inputs And Operations
| Area | Typical concern |
|------|------------------|
| Merchant Center linkage | Account link, feed availability, diagnostics state |
| Product data | Required attributes, GTINs, titles, images, pricing, availability |
| Structure | Product groups, campaign splits, custom-label governance |
| Bidding and budgets | Standard Shopping vs retail Performance Max operating model |
| Diagnostics | Feed errors, policy mismatches, price mismatches, landing-page consistency |

### Reporting / Diagnostic Surfaces
- Merchant Center diagnostics, Shopping performance reads, product-group structure, and feed-linked policy state are core evidence.
- Retail Performance Max interplay should be explained explicitly when the user asks how Shopping and PMax overlap or differ.
- For AI Max for Shopping, product titles, assets, landing pages, and search terms are current reporting lenses, but optimization should wait for the documented learning/ramp-up period and use account-level performance evidence.

### What Not To Present As Fact
- Do not promise fixed CTR or ROAS lifts from GTINs, titles, or custom-label structure.
- Do not present old Shopping-priority or query-sculpting doctrine as timeless platform law.
- Do not discuss Shopping setup without naming the Merchant Center dependency.

- Sections titled "Practical", "Discipline", "Operator" or "Workflow" are **Practitioner rules**: experience, not Google policy.
